[/list]

notes.title: Alex
notes.content:
Today's big update adds a new girl, location, mini-games and achievements to the game. In addition, the update made it easier to get new levels with girls, fixed a lot of bugs and improved compatibility with older video cards.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/b0SzuW9.jpeg[/img]
The main game of the location is arkanoid. There are 10 levels in total, but if the level seems too difficult, you can skip it.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OCPz984.jpeg[/img]
You can try to earn money at roulette. That's how lucky you are.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0kMM1Lz.jpeg[/img]
You can also try to hit the jackpot!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kfaPRdb.jpeg[/img]
New mini-games radically change the economy in the game, and along with changes in the balance of levels, the passage of the game becomes especially exciting!
